    Uses beyond delivery and smuggling. Each count is small and rests on a handful of reports; read them as existence, not frequency.

    What this dataset is not

    State or hybrid incidents (airport closures, overflights of military sites, suspected espionage) are excluded. They are listed here so that they are not mistaken for criminal use.

          Method

          How this was collected

          Scope: drones used by criminal actors in a European country, 1 January 2021 to 29 October 2026, one row per event (a flight, drop, interception, seizure, arrest or court outcome). State or hybrid incidents, police use of drones and extremist plots are excluded and listed below.

          Discovery: Google News queries across country editions in national languages, in half-year windows; national court databases; parliamentary written-question archives; official press rooms; and searches per country by researchers working in the national language. Every search is logged.

          Each incident, statistic and claim carries a verbatim quote. A script re-fetches every incident source and checks that the quote is still there; incidents whose quote could not be re-found carry the mark ⚠. They are kept, not removed.

          Collection effort

          Coverage by country

          Searches run by the researcher covering the country (a researcher covering several countries is counted once per country and marked shared), Google News feed requests for that country's edition, articles fetched from the country's own web domain, and events documented. For the Nordic countries, parliamentary and archive collections were walked page by page in bulk, so their page-request counts are high while the events documented stay at or near zero.
